info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Details API
info.description: The Customer Account Details API enables users to access detailed information about specific customer accounts. By using the API, developers can retrieve data related to accounts linked to individual customers, facilitating effective account management and analysis. This API is commonly used by financial services and customer support teams to provide insights into account statuses and transactions. Use cases include generating reports, troubleshooting account issues, and enhancing user experiences through personalized account information.

get.summary: Retrieve account details for a specific customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific account belonging to a customer. You can use this data to understand account balances, transaction history, and account status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving account information for a specific customer and account. This body should include any necessary parameters or filters required to customize the response.

GetCustomerAccountDetailsRequest.title: Customer Account Operations Request Body
